newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico names Gutierrez deputy trade minister.
newsitem.headline: Mexico names Gutierrez deputy trade minister.

text.p: Mexico's Trade Ministry said Monday Israel Gutierrez Guerrero was designated deputy minister in charge of internal trade.
He will take over from Eugenio Carrion Rodriguez, who has been named assistant director general of the state development bank Nacional Financiera (Nafin).
Before his designation as deputy trade minister, Gutierrez Guerrero was chief assessor to the ministry's external trade office.
